leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a TypeScript type definition for a navigation schema with typed routes.
Initialize a constant object that implements the navigation schema type.
Implement a type guard function to validate route objects at runtime.
Apply the type guard within a conditional block to control program flow.
Manipulate the navigation schema to add a new typed route property.
Integrate the navigation schema and guard into a simple route-checking utility.
lessonTitle: Build typed nav schema and guards
